notes: Form generation with the colour 'WASHINGTON COUNTY / UTAH' logo - a filled spreadsheet whose cover DOES carry the '$50.00 or less' aggregate line. index.csv says candidate 'Ryan Sullivan', office 'Clerk/Auditor'; the form agrees - 'Full name of Candidate Ryan Sullivan', 'Candidate for Office Of Clerk-Auditor' (hyphen rather than slash). Period Jan-24 to Jun-24, signed 6/12/2024, clerk RECEIVED stamp JUN 12 2024.
